newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley raised.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers analyst Raphael Soifer said he raised his fourth quarter earnings per share view on Morgan Stanley Group Inc to $1.56 from $1.41 and his full year 1996 EPS view to $6.15 from $6.00.
-- He kept his short-term hold and long-term market perform.

-- "Market conditions in Morgan Stanley's fiscal fourth quarter ... have been even better than we had anticipated, although not quite up to those of the second quarter which ended in May," Soifer said in a research note.
-- Shares were up 1/8 at 60 in midmorning exchange trading.
